written_scope: Total-variation convergence of the minimum law and countably additive component densities, conditional on the written uniform first-passage Proposition 4.1.
Existence of finite odd-target visitation-profile laws and odd-target predecessor densities, from Proposition 4.1 alone.
Coarse first-passage landing lower bound x^(7/10), outside O(x^(-c)), from Tao Proposition 1.9 and Chernoff plus the affine iteration formula.
Using that overshoot bound, existence of every finite positive-target visitation-profile law and every fixed positive-target predecessor density.
Sum of predecessor densities in a length-L interval is at most 256 L^sigma for odd targets and 512 L^sigma for all targets, using the written finite-path packing theorem; sigma=H_2(log_3 2)<19/20.
Predecessor densities increase along a forward orbit to its component density, using tightness of the written minimum law.
Targets divisible by three have only repeated-doubling predecessors, hence density zero; the independently replayed PLD theorem gives positive density at every other target.
Under the written minimum law and the verified external PLD theorem, universal convergence is equivalent to p_1=1 and p_1>0; the equality p_1=1 remains unproved.
review_details: The initial odd-target argument does not directly cover even targets; the separate overshoot proof controls the final halving segment.
Initial removal of powers of two changes an all-target profile only for O_A(log X) starts up to X.
The sum over targets is finite before taking a density limit; no arbitrary countable-union density rule is used.
The forward-orbit density limit uses finitely many possible minima up to B, then the probability-law tail as B tends to infinity.
In the overshoot proof alpha=1.001, n0=floor(log_2(x)/10), 19n0/10<=S<=3n0, 3^5<2^8, and alpha^2-3/100=972001/1000000<1.
The written first-passage proof was reread against Tao v7: the Fourier tilt is constant under paired-sum conditioning, and the shifted renewal parameter contains 2*m0*(2-log_2(3)).
